notes.title: New dynamic item generation system and character system
notes.content:
+ Now you have Character. It will Save and Load automatically when you start or exit game rounds.
+ New boss and quests loot system called "Loot boxes"
     • You can open it only in safe zones!
     • You loose loot boxes if you pick up it but not reach the safe zone (leaving game or died)
     • Loot boxes level is equivalent to your current difficulty level!
+ New experience system
     • Now in game presented 5 difficulty levels
     • When you die, you will return to last safe zone, but you loose your loot capsules
+New items system with "Item level"
     • When you loot box, you will earn one item equivalent to your current character level
+ You can find additional loot boxes in survival maps!
